## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `fd3f1f3ef3a7211bc436ffa1cc9482357c66133f`
Local-runs: probe — the five scripts' own `--self-test` batteries on the head, four ablation legs (each restored with `git checkout`, `git status --porcelain` empty), and a read-only reader probe (28 synthetic bodies plus the live PR #28023 and PR #27964 threads, driven through the four readers in a head worktree and an `origin/main` worktree) were executed locally, because the card's wanted item 1 is a behavioural claim about the readers that no check-run prints; the register, the skill-id lint, the line ratchet and the token ratchet were run read-only beside them
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md (:33) + scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEAD_SHA_LINE` :12668, `FENCE_LINE` :12679, `contractReviewHeadSha` :12711, `contractReviewHeadMatch` :12764, `latestContractReviewOnHead` :12781, H51 pins :33506-33521), scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs (`RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS` :2062, `HEAD_SHA_KEY_ANYWHERE` :2069, `headShaKeyLine` :2072, `recordKeyedLineRefusals` :2092, `recordLineRefusalText` :2105, CLI wiring :3894, battery :5300-5324), scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (battery floor :2073, pins :2235-2246); read but not reviewed: scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (`keyLineRegex` :534, `locateReviewOfRecord` :1991, `--template`), scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs (`recordReading` :196), scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs (`loadRecordRecognisers` :887, `recordVerdict` :965), `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER` (check-half-states.mjs :12624)

### ① Derived judgments

Base is `origin/main` at `e1dde1a5c` (merge base; the branch is the single commit `fd3f1f3ef`; `origin/main` has since moved to `5aee20654` with no touch of the four files). `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28042` on the head: 1 of 4 paths hits the register (`.claude/**`), Tier S, size 173 lines under the human-merge threshold; the three `scripts/pm/**` paths are off the register. The register and the PR body agree. Every claim the diff makes, judged against the tree and by running it:

1. The reader's three positional rules. `contractReviewHeadSha` (:12711) walks the body split on `\r?\n`; a line matching `FENCE_LINE` (three or more backticks or tildes with up to three spaces of indent) toggles `fenced` and is skipped; a fenced line is skipped; until a line matches `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER` (blockquoted heading admitted, `###` refused) every line is skipped; among the lines that remain the FIRST matching `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEAD_SHA_LINE` wins. The key regex (:12668) drops the optional blockquote-marker and list-bullet prefixes the base carried and keeps bold, backticks, leading whitespace and the value half (`(?:[ \t]|\*\*)*` then `H51_SHA_SPAN.source`, so the `g` flag is not inherited). `contractReviewHeadMatch` and `latestContractReviewOnHead` are untouched and still reach the head through this one function. TRUE as the PR body and the docblock state.
2. One shared definition. At the head, by grep over scripts/pm: `latestContractReviewOnHead` (H43 via `h43HandoffReading`), `locateReviewOfRecord` (record-recognisers :1991, importing `contractReviewHeadMatch`), `recordReading` (check-owed-reviews :196, through `locateReviewOfRecord`) and the guard's `recordVerdict` (:965, through the lazily loaded `locate`) all reach the head through `contractReviewHeadSha`; post-stamped now imports it too. No second parser; no other production predicate moves. TRUE.
3. The core question, answered by execution. A probe (scratchpad `probe.mjs`) imported the four modules from a worktree at the PR head and from a worktree at `origin/main`, built 28 synthetic bodies and the live PR #28023 (4 comments) and PR #27964 (10 comments) threads fetched by REST, and drove each through `contractReviewHeadSha`, `latestContractReviewOnHead`, `locateReviewOfRecord`, `recordReading` and `recordVerdict` (recognisers from `loadRecordRecognisers()`, a `.claude/**` Tier S path, repo `objectstack`) at head A `8216bec4` and cited head B `b3d92fee`. At the PR head:
   - the four ruling shapes, each naming B ABOVE the record's own A line: blockquoted, bulleted (`-` and `* **bold**`), fenced (backtick, tilde, fence indented three spaces, blockquoted fence) and pre-heading: every reader answers null / absent / stale / absent at B and A / found / current / stands at A. On base every one of them read B (found at B, absent at A). CLOSED, exactly as the PR body states.
   - B under an earlier `## Summary` heading, B under a nested `### Contract review`, a second `## Contract review` section naming B AFTER the record's own: absent at B, found at A on head (base read B for the first two). CLOSED.
   - a fully blockquoted record on B: names null on head (base named B, and with a quoted `Reviewed-by:` would have been found at B). A quotation alone now contributes no head. CLOSED.
   - CRLF record, CRLF with a quoted B above own A, own A with trailing prose naming B, prose mentioning the key mid-sentence above own A, a one-space-indented own line, an unclosed fence, B only in prose: all read as the PR body says.
   - template-shaped record (`contractReviewTemplateLines({ headSha: A })`): found at A, absent at B. Live PR #28023 record 6518659368 at its real head `40b5a25e`: H43 6518659368/PASS, located found, owed current, guard stands; at a wrong head: absent / stale / absent. Live PR #27964 full thread at `b3d92fee`: found 6516322954; at `8216bec4`: found 6516042954; truncated before 06:15Z at `b3d92fee`: null / absent / stale / absent, at `8216bec4`: found 6516042954. Identical readings on base for every live case. No live record reads differently.
   - RESIDUAL, named B on the head AND on base (no regression, not loosened): a `Head-sha:` line inside an INDENTED code block (four spaces or a tab) above own A; a nested fence (four-backtick outer, three-backtick inner, B inside) and a mismatched-character fence (backtick open, tilde line inside) — `FENCE_LINE` toggles on any fence line regardless of character or length, so a line that CommonMark renders as fence content is read; and an unquoted paste of a record on B placed before the author's own heading (first section wins, which the self-test pins as the rule). Should-fixes 2 and 3.
   - RESIDUAL, read DIFFERENTLY on the head (the one shape this PR reads worse than base): a fully blockquoted, signed record on A (the heading, the head line and the `Reviewed-by:` line each carrying the blockquote marker) followed by a plain prose line opening `Head-sha: B`. Base read A (the quoted line, a head the quoted record did review); the head reads B and `locateReviewOfRecord` answers found at B, signed through the quoted `Reviewed-by:` that `keyLineRegex` still tolerates. Cause: the blockquoted heading opens the scope (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER` admits the blockquote marker, and the docblock keeps it "exactly as the locator finds the record"), the quoted head line is refused, and the reader falls through to the next plain key line. The seat's corpus measured 0 blockquoted headings in 709 records; no protocol line (`Contract-review-claim`, `-handoff`, `-hold`) spells the head as `Head-sha:`; `post-stamped` would not refuse it (it reads B). Not blocking: it needs the author to write the record's own key line as prose under a quotation, a shape the previous review graded should-fix at p2 in its more natural form. Should-fix 1.
   So after this PR no reader admits a PASS for a head named only on a quoted, bulleted, fenced or pre-heading `Head-sha:` line, on a line after a nested or earlier heading, or in a second section after the record's own; the accept set is the same or narrower than base in 27 of 28 probed shapes and wider in the one shape above.
4. Edge 3, the writer. `recordKeyedLineRefusals` (:2092) keeps the record-only scope (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER.test(text)` first), then refuses when `HEAD_SHA_KEY_ANYWHERE` (`/head-sha[ \t`*]*:/i`, presence anywhere) matches and the IMPORTED `contractReviewHeadSha` reads null; the `Local-runs` row follows; both rows are returned together, `Head-sha` first. Driven on the head (scratchpad `refusal-probe.mjs`): quoted-only, bulleted-only, fenced-only, pre-heading-only, key-in-span, bare hex, lowercase key, `Head-Sha`, six-hex span: each refused with the offending line quoted and `RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS['Head-sha']` printed; no key at all: untouched; an ordinary comment, an os-dev-report JSON and a triage-style comment mentioning the key mid-sentence with no line-initial heading: untouched; record 6518659368 (key mentioned mid-sentence many times, own line plain) and every other live comment on both threads: untouched. The structural pin reads the CLI wiring (`options.mode === 'comment'`, :3894) and both imports off the file's own source, and asserts no `function contractReviewHeadSha` is restated. The import is one name added to the `./check-half-states.mjs` import list post-stamped already carried at module scope (base :965); `check-half-states.mjs` imports only `./seat-record.mjs` among pm siblings, so no cycle; module load of post-stamped measured 138 ms on head against 137 ms on base. TRUE. One loudness false positive, not an admission: a comment that quotes a record's heading at line start and mentions `Head-sha:` in prose with no plain line is refused at write time (should-fix 4).
5. Edge 2, the rules text. contract-review.md :33 「同形 = `## Contract review` 题头、`Head-sha:` 行独占码段、①②③ 逐项、独立性对、PASS/FAIL。」 is true against the new reader (the head is read off the `Head-sha:` line's own span and nowhere else) and matches the key-line style :36 already uses. Line count 60 on head and on base (`wc -l`); the line is 117 bytes under `MAX_LINE_BYTES` 120; `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` reads contract-review.md at 60 lines (ceiling 60), exit 0; `check-skill-id-lint.mjs --self-test` then the lint: 105 files clean against `/#[0-9]{3,}/g`, exit 0, and a grep of the file for `#` followed by three or more digits finds nothing; `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: 56 authored bundle files within ceilings, exit 0. The line does not state the positional rules (below the heading, not quoted, bulleted or fenced); the shape is defined by `--template`, which prints the line second and plain, and `RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS` prints the full rule at the write. Acceptable at this byte budget.
6. Self-tests, run on the committed head in the worktree, exit captured before any pipe: `check-half-states --self-test` exit 0, 5102 cases; `record-recognisers --self-test` exit 0, 336; `post-stamped --self-test` exit 0, 743 across 26 batteries; `check-owed-reviews --self-test` exit 0, 65 in 9 batteries; `check-governed-queue-guard --self-test` exit 0, 403. All five counts match the PR body. The raised floors (recognisers 10 to 13, post-stamped 9 to 17) are met.
7. Ablation at the head, each leg restored with `git checkout` and `git status --porcelain` empty afterwards: (A) blockquote and bullet tolerance restored into the key regex: half-states 3 of 5102 red, recognisers 2 of 336, post-stamped 4 of 743; (B) `let belowHeading = true`: 3 / 1 / 1; (C) `if (fenced && false) continue`: 4 / 2 / 1 (the tilde-and-CRLF pin among them); (D) the write-time `Head-sha` refusal disabled: 0 / 0 / 5. Every red pin is one of the new ones and the seat's reported counts (3/2/4, 3/1/1, 4/2/1, 5) reproduce exactly.
8. Measure-first. The 709 / 707 / 2 / 0 counts (REST `issues/comments?since=2026-10-23`, 113 pages) are the seat's own measurement, read not re-run; the two no-key records named (6360650327 on PR #25399, 6397040906 on PR #25774) are the ones the #28023 review spot-checked. The live probe in item 3 is this review's own sample and agrees.
9. Scope. The diff touches exactly the four files the claim's file surface names; record-recognisers.mjs moves pins and a battery floor only. PR body: `Fixes #28024` on its own line, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; label `skip-changeset` is right for PM tooling and skill text with no published package.
10. Not measured here: ESLint on the touched scripts (no node_modules in the worktree); the `Lint · ESLint` check-run on the head is success. The seat's 56-family gate reconciliation is read, not re-run.

### ② Semver level

No published package is touched (`.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only); `skip-changeset` carried. `Clause-②: no` is right; no narrowing declared or present.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Served tier versus face: the register answers Tier S on one `.claude/**` path, so the governed rules-text face applies and this record is served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, the tier the queue guard will read.
- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (attribution comment names os-elon-musk); no non-bot login to record.
- Contract-review-claim: comment 6520495482 names the seat session and this head; no competing claim, no hold, no hand-off.
- CI at review time (50 check runs on `fd3f1f3e`): success on Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI release & engine gates, the three Lint · scoped jobs, TypeScript Type Check and its four sub-jobs, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test UI, Test Core and both shards, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Live required-set sweep, Platform checklist gate sweep, Release section-coverage sweep, board snapshot, Auto Label, filter, Plan Test Core shards; still in_progress: Live half-state sweep; the rest skipped by path filter. No failure. The final all-green reading is the landing gate's.
- Seat report deviations: (a) assignment and review request skipped at PR creation per SKILL.md, accepted; (b) `check:platform-checklist --changed-from` not run because no export was renamed or removed, verified (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEAD_SHA_LINE` keeps its name, `FENCE_LINE` is module-private), accepted; (c) the discarded first heading-scope ablation (in-loop mutation stayed green) is disclosed and the re-run leg is the one reproduced here, accepted.
- Premise: `premise_still_valid: true`; base `e1dde1a5c` carried the blockquote and bullet prefixes in the key regex and the first-line-anywhere reader, and contract-review.md :33 read 「head sha 独占码段」 (read off `git show`).
- `open_questions` empty; the out-of-scope observation (`keyLineRegex` still tolerates blockquote and bullet for the three other keys) is the root of should-fix 1 and is answered there.
- Draft PR, `mergeable_state: unstable` while the sweep runs; Tier S landing by the owning seat after this record and all-green.

### ④ Design judgment

Rules face, per `hits` file, and the gate the rule names read as one change:

- contract-review.md :33. The rule now names the line the readers read, in the form the sibling :36 already uses, inside the same byte budget and with no line added. It states the shape, not the reader's positional rules, which is right for a one-line definition whose copyable form is `--template` and whose write-time refusal prints the full rule. Holds.
- The reader (check-half-states.mjs). The design is the right one for the ruling: positional rules a single-line regex cannot carry live in the one walker every consumer shares, the key regex refuses the two decorations that mark a citation, and the fence toggle is deliberately minimal. Fail-closed in the direction the ruling names: every quoted, bulleted, fenced or pre-heading line is prose, a quotation alone names nothing, and the repair is at the write. The cost of the chosen bounds is the residual set in ①.3: the walker's scope opens on a blockquoted heading (so a quotation can open the scope for a plain line that follows it), its fence model ignores fence character and length, and its key regex tolerates any leading whitespace (so an indented code block reads). Each is a key line in a code-rendered or quotation position that no protocol line produces and the corpus has none of; each is a one-token tightening. Holds, with should-fixes 1 to 3.
- The writer (post-stamped.mjs). Importing the reader and refusing on present-and-null is exactly the discipline the `Local-runs` row set, so a record cannot be posted in a shape every reader files as no head. The presence test is deliberately looser than the line (anywhere, case-blind) so a decorated key is caught; the price is a refusal on a non-record comment that quotes a record heading at line start and mentions the key in prose, which is loudness in the right direction. Holds, with should-fix 4.
- No new gate, no label write, no workflow touched; consistent with triage 6518934332.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-l6ibnp`
Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Must-fix: none.

Should-fix:
1. `contractReviewHeadSha` (check-half-states.mjs :12711) opens its scope on a BLOCKQUOTED heading, so a fully quoted signed record followed by a plain prose line opening with the `Head-sha:` key is read as a record naming that prose line's sha (probed: found at B, signed through the quoted `Reviewed-by:`; base read the quoted record's own A). Open the scope only on an unquoted heading (the blockquoted-heading tolerance belongs to the locator's filter, where a fully quoted record now reads null anyway), or refuse a `Reviewed-by:` line that is blockquoted when the head line was read below a quoted heading. One token, one pin shaped like the probe; 0 live instances (the seat measured 0 blockquoted headings). File as a follow-up card from this record.
2. The key regex (:12668) still begins `^[ \t]*`, so a `Head-sha:` line inside an INDENTED code block (four spaces or a tab) above the record's own line is read as the head, on head and on base alike. `^[ ]{0,3}` (CommonMark's paragraph indent, the bound `FENCE_LINE` already uses) closes it; the template prints no indent and the corpus has none.
3. `FENCE_LINE` toggles on any fence line, so a nested fence (four-backtick outer, three-backtick inner) and a mismatched close (backtick open, tilde inside) let a line that renders as fence content be read. Track the opening fence's character and length and close only on the same character at the same or greater length. Same follow-up as 1 and 2.
4. `HEAD_SHA_KEY_ANYWHERE` (post-stamped.mjs :2069) tests presence anywhere, so a non-record comment that quotes a record heading at line start and mentions `Head-sha:` mid-sentence is refused at write time with "a `Head-sha` key is present". Loudness only; a line-initial presence test with decoration tolerated (the `keyLineRegex` shape) would keep the catch for decorated lines and drop the prose false positive. Rides later.
5. contract-review.md :33 names the line but not that it sits below the heading; when the file has a line of headroom, or in `--template`'s `Head-sha` note, say 「题头之下」 so the rule and `RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS` agree in words. Cosmetic.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2e75b19392b1acff5c999da52311e167042a11de`
Local-runs: probe — the five scripts' own `--self-test` batteries on the head, four ablation legs of the delta in a detached worktree (each restored with `git checkout`, `git status --porcelain` empty), the previous record's reader probe re-run with 27 added shapes (56 synthetic bodies plus the live PR #28023 and PR #27964 threads, driven through the four readers in worktrees at this head, at the previous head `fd3f1f3e` and at `origin/main`), the write-side refusal probe with 14 added shapes, and a read-only corpus scan (11305 issue comments updated since 2026-10-23, fetched by REST in 114 pages, driven through the three readers and the write-side refusal) were executed locally, because the card's wanted item 1 is a behavioural claim about the readers that no check-run prints and the delta changes the reader's scope, indent and fence rules; `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28042` was run read-only beside them
Scope: DELTA review of `2e75b193` over `fd3f1f3e` (one commit), with the full PR in view. scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEAD_SHA_LINE` :12671, `FENCE_LINE` :12684, `contractReviewHeadSha` :12721, H51 pins :33519-33529), scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs (battery floor :4090, pin :5321), scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (battery floor :2073, pins :2188 and :2246-2247); untouched in the delta and read again: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md (:33), post-stamped.mjs `recordKeyedLineRefusals` (:2092) and `RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS` (:2062), record-recognisers.mjs `locateReviewOfRecord` (:1991) and `keyLineRegex` (:534), check-owed-reviews.mjs `recordReading`, check-governed-queue-guard.mjs `recordVerdict`, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER` (check-half-states.mjs :12624). The previous PASS on `fd3f1f3ef3a7211bc436ffa1cc9482357c66133f` covers that head only; this record is the review of `2e75b193`.

### ① Derived judgments

Base is `origin/main`, merge base `e1dde1a5c`; `origin/main` has since moved to `bc496bf7d` with no touch of the four reviewed files or the two consumer scripts (`git diff --stat e1dde1a5c bc496bf7d` on the six paths is empty). The delta is one commit touching three `scripts/pm/**` files (+51 / -24); `git diff fd3f1f3e 2e75b193 -- .claude` is empty, so contract-review.md is unchanged and the Tier S face is the PR's, not the delta's. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28042` at the head: 1 of 4 paths hits the register (`.claude/**`), Tier S, 202 changed lines (+169 / -33) under the human-merge threshold. Each of the dev's three delta claims, judged by reading the code and by running it:

1. Heading scope. `contractReviewHeadSha` (:12721) now sets `belowHeading` only when `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER` matches AND the line does not begin, after optional whitespace, with the blockquote marker (a second, two-token regex on the same line); the marker itself (:12624) keeps its optional blockquote marker so the locator, H43's filter, owed-reviews and the guard still see a quoted-heading comment as a record, and `recordKeyedLineRefusals` still scopes on it. Probed at this head: the previous record's should-fix 1 shape (a fully quoted signed record on A followed by a plain prose line opening `Head-sha: B`) names null, and every reader answers null / absent / stale / absent at B AND at A (base and `fd3f1f3e` read B with `locateReviewOfRecord` found at B through the quoted signature; `origin/main` read A). The same with CRLF, with the plain `Reviewed-by:` added below, and with a space before the marker: null. A quoted heading alone over a plain own line: null (previously A). A quoted record on B followed by the real unquoted record on A: A, found at A, absent at B (`fd3f1f3e` and base read B). The locator's flipped pin (:2188) now asserts ABSENT and names its reason. TRUE.
2. Indent. `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEAD_SHA_LINE` (:12671) opens `^[ ]{0,3}`; the key-to-colon gap keeps `[ \t]*`. Probed: a four-space or tab-indented line naming B above the own A line is skipped and A is read (`fd3f1f3e` read B); a four-space, tab, or four-space-under-a-paragraph own line alone names null (`fd3f1f3e` read A); a one-, two- and three-space own line reads A; two spaces then `Head-sha:` then a tab then the span reads A. TRUE. The heading marker still admits any leading whitespace, so a heading indented four spaces (a code block in CommonMark) still opens the scope over a plain line; this is unchanged from base and both prior heads and is below the key line's own bound (should-fix 7).
3. Fence. `FENCE_LINE` (:12684) captures the run; the walker records `{ ch, len }` on open and closes only on the same character with a run at least `len` long; other fence lines inside are content and skipped; an unmatched fence runs to the end. Probed: four-backtick outer with a three-backtick inner naming B then own A: A (`fd3f1f3e` read B); backtick open with a tilde line and B inside: A (`fd3f1f3e` read B); tilde open with a backtick pair inside: A; a longer closing run (five backticks over three, four tildes over three) closes and A is read; a fence with an info string closes on the bare run; an open fence followed by `~~~ B ~~~` and never closed names null, as does an unclosed fence before the own line and a four-backtick fence "closed" by three; a fence indented three spaces and closed at column 0 closes; a fence line indented four spaces is not a fence (CommonMark agrees) and the plain B line after it is read on every head alike. CRLF nested fence: A. TRUE. Residual, same on this head, `fd3f1f3e` and base: a closing line with trailing text (three backticks then prose, which CommonMark reads as fence content, not a close) closes the fence here, so a `Head-sha:` line after it is read (should-fix 6).
4. Monotone across the whole probe. 56 synthetic shapes times three worktrees: between `fd3f1f3e` and this head the reader's answer changes in 19 shapes, and every change is either something-to-null or the cited B to the author's own plain A; between `origin/main` and this head it changes in 39 shapes, each of the same two kinds; in NO shape does this head name a sha that a plain line below an unquoted heading did not write. The 28 shapes of the previous probe read exactly as the previous record states except the five the delta was asked to change (quoted heading over a plain line; indented code and tab above own A; nested and mismatched fence), each now narrower. The four readers agree in every row: H43 `latestContractReviewOnHead`, `locateReviewOfRecord`, owed `recordReading` and the guard's `recordVerdict` all reach the head through `contractReviewHeadSha` (grep over scripts/pm at the head: no second parser), so a null here is absent / stale / absent everywhere. Template-shaped record (`contractReviewTemplateLines({ headSha: A })`): found at A, absent at B. Live PR #28023 record 6518659368 at `40b5a25e`: H43 6518659368/PASS, located found, owed current, guard stands; at a wrong head: absent / stale / absent. Live PR #27964 full thread at `b3d92fee`: found 6516322954; at `8216bec4`: found 6516042954; truncated before 06:15Z: null at `b3d92fee`, found 6516042954 at `8216bec4`. Identical to the previous record's readings and to base.
5. No live record is orphaned. Corpus scan (scratchpad `corpus-scan.mjs`): of 11305 issue comments updated since 2026-10-23, 713 carry the heading marker; 0 have a blockquoted heading line (all 713 have a plain line-initial one), 0 have a `Head-sha` key line indented four spaces or a tab, 1 has any fence line, 711 carry a `Head-sha` key. `contractReviewHeadSha` at this head, at `fd3f1f3e` and at `origin/main` returns the SAME value on all 713 bodies (0 differences in either pair); the 2 nulls are the two no-key legacy records the previous reviews named. 711 records name a head and all 711 carry a `Reviewed-by:` line.
